title: Two-factor policy
subtitle: Choose when users must set up 2FA

warning.title: Applies on next login
warning.description: When 2FA is required, users without it will be prompted to set it up the next time they sign in.

optional.label: Optional
optional.description: Users can enable 2FA from their account settings.

privileged.label: Required for admins
privileged.description: Require 2FA for users with elevated permissions.

success.title: 2FA policy updated
success.description: The new requirement will apply on the next login.
